# CLI reference

FunScript 0.1.0. This page is generated from [the CLI command catalogue](../../src/cli/commands.ts).

## Commands

### `funscript build`

```text
funscript build <file.fun|file.funx...> [--out <file>] [--outDir <dir>] [--sourcemap] [--no-check]
```

Build FunScript files to TypeScript or TSX.

```sh
funscript build src/Button.funx --sourcemap
```

### `funscript emit`

```text
funscript emit <file.fun|file.funx> [--out <file.ts|file.tsx>] [--sourcemap]
```

Compile one FunScript file to TypeScript or TSX.

```sh
funscript emit src/main.fun --out src/main.ts --sourcemap
```

### `funscript check`

```text
funscript check [file.fun|file.funx...]
```

Statically type-check files with the TypeScript API.

```sh
funscript check examples/shapes.fun
```

### `funscript run`

```text
funscript run <file.fun|file.funx> [--no-check]
```

Compile and run a FunScript program with Node.js.

```sh
funscript run examples/hello.fun
```

### `funscript repl`

```text
funscript repl
```

Start the interactive REPL.

```sh
funscript repl
```

### `funscript lsp`

```text
funscript lsp [--stdio]
```

Start the Language Server Protocol server.

```sh
funscript lsp --stdio
```

### `funscript fmt`

```text
funscript fmt <file.fun...> [--check]
```

Format FunScript source code or check its formatting.

```sh
funscript fmt examples/hello.fun --check
```

### `funscript version`

```text
funscript version
```

Display the FunScript version.

Aliases: `-v`, `--version`.

```sh
funscript version
```
